findings.title: Size fallback replaces the whole array, discarding the common prefix and suffix
findings.why: The prefix and suffix are already trimmed before the size check. When the differing middle is large, the code still replaces the entire array. A 100k-item array with one changed element at each end plus a 2k-item changed middle produces a patch holding the full array. The doc comment on createPatch says only the differing parts are described, so this contradicts it. Replacing or splicing just the middle range would keep the patch small. Separately, the cell limit counts the middle only, so large arrays whose middle is small are still diffed precisely, which makes the fallback behaviour inconsistent.

findings.title: New large-array fallback is untested and undocumented
findings.why: The repo has test/create-patch.test.ts, but I found no test that exercises the MAX_LCS_CELLS threshold or checks that the fallback patch round-trips. The createPatch doc comment doesn't mention the fallback, so callers can't know that patches for big arrays are no longer minimal.
